newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-ENQVIST WIN LEVELS TIE FOR SWEDEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST WIN LEVELS TIE FOR SWEDEN.

text.p: Swede Thomas Enqvist pulled a point back for his country by beating Switzerland's Lorenzo Manta to level an intriguing Davis Cup World Group first round tie on Friday.
Enqvist came through 7-6 7-6 6-2 after watching Marc Rosset beat his Swedish teammate Magnus Larsson 7-6 3-6 6-4 4-6 13-11 in a marathon encounter lasting almost four hours.
The lanky, fair-haired Rosset, ranked 24th in the world, sported bright orange shoes but it was his more familiar power serve which gave him the edge in the protracted final set.

Sweden, who lost to France in last year's final, always suspected Rosset would present a threat but knew little about the 22-year-old Manta, a player ranked 328th in the world who still managed to force his opponent to tie-breaks in the first two sets.

1,500 spectators packed the local sports stadium in Lulea, an arctic town 940 kms (580 miles) north of Stockholm, but Sweden's non-playing captain Carl-Axel Hageskog expects a stern challenge from the visitors in Saturday's doubles.
Davis Cup newcomer Mikael Tillstrom will team up with experienced doubles player Nicklas Kulti to face the Swiss duo of Rosset and Manta.
